description: What tools/actions.py may bind an action to on the Vita TV variant. Read only by Python tooling at build time; the engine never sees this file. Derived from engine/include/platform/vita/tv/Platform.h's TranslatePadButtons, which is the identity (this variant pairs with a full DualShock-class pad, so L3/R3/L2/R2 are real buttons here, unlike handheld). HasTouchSurfaces() is false; PlatformCapability::AnalogTriggers is false for the whole Vita family, so there are no trigger sources even though L2/R2 exist as buttons.
